title: Structured Data Extraction for Logistics
business: A regional logistics firm managing high volumes of unstructured shipping manifests.
problem: The firm struggles with manual data entry errors when converting unstructured shipping manifests into structured JSON formats for their database.
solution: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct provides improved capabilities in understanding structured data and generating structured outputs, specifically JSON, allowing for automated parsing of shipping manifests.
steps: Install the latest transformers library to ensure compatibility with Qwen2.5 architecture.
Initialize the AutoModelForCausalLM and AutoTokenizer using the Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct model identifier.
Define a system prompt instructing the model to extract specific fields like destination and weight into a JSON format.
Apply the chat template to format the input manifest data correctly for the model.
Generate the structured output using the model's generation pipeline and parse the resulting JSON.
outcome: The firm achieves consistent, machine-readable data extraction from shipping manifests, significantly reducing manual entry overhead.
limitation: While the model excels at structured output, it has a fixed context length of 32,768 tokens; verify that input manifests do not exceed this limit to prevent truncation errors.

diagram.title: Manifest Processing Pipeline
diagram.description: The flow of data from raw input to structured database entry.

code.content:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
# Load model and tokenizer
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct", device_map="auto")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct")
# Prepare prompt for structured extraction
messages = [{"role": "system", "content": "Extract data to JSON."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Manifest: Box 1, 5kg, NYC."}]
text = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
# Generate output
inputs = tokenizer([text], return_tensors="pt").to(model.device)
generated = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=512)
code.explanation: This code demonstrates initializing the model and using the chat template to prepare a prompt for structured data extraction as required by the logistics scenario.
